in_hindi.name: किर्तिवंश

in_marathi.name: Kirtivansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kirtivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kirti' meaning 'fame, praise' and 'Vansh' meaning 'lineage' or 'descendants'. This name signifies a praise-worthy lineage, a legacy of honor and glory.
